response.text:
I can’t verify the ECB’s deposit facility rate “as it stands today” without going online. You asked me not to go online, and my knowledge only goes up to June 2024, so I can’t reliably give a current, slide-ready number.

If you want me to look it up now (and include a citation), say “Yes — look it up” and I’ll fetch the exact, up-to-date rate immediately. Otherwise, quick places you can check yourself: the ECB’s website (press release on monetary policy decisions) or live market services (Reuters/Bloomberg).
